facts.fact: Decree 2020-150/PR/MI of 13 July 2020 is made under Article 9 of Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L of 21 January 2019 on identification of natural persons, the national identification number and a national register, treating the law as the existing basis; the law is an Assembly law and the decree is a presidential decree.
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)

facts.fact: The decree describes the NNI created by the 2019 law as a unique, unambiguous code and a 'digital instrument' of 12 positions combining civil-status and personal data.
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)

facts.fact: Decree 2020-150/PR/MI of 13 July 2020, made under Loi n° 39/AN/19, sets the composition, features and scope of the NNI and requires public, semi-public and private administrations, hospitals, schools, telecom, water and electricity bodies and traders to carry it on their documents.
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)
